rationale: Cyber-attacks hit supermarket freezers across 10 EU countries including Portugal, forcing food disposal; bomb threats ground flights in Spain and across EU, affecting Iberian travel.

top_events.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
top_events.label: Cyber-attacks hit Portugal supermarket freezers
top_events.summary: Coordinated cyber-attacks affected freezers from Estonia to Portugal, forcing retailers to discard food. Direct infrastructure disruption in Portugal and across EU.

top_events.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
top_events.label: Bomb threats ground Spain EU flights
top_events.summary: Multiple flights in Spain, Poland, Bulgaria, and Italy checked for explosives after separate threats. Disruption to Iberian neighbor aviation and EU travel.

top_events.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
top_events.label: Spain transport minister resigns after crash
top_events.summary: At least 69 people killed and dozens injured in train collision south of Madrid; minister resigns. Major tragedy in neighboring Iberian country.

short_summary: Cyber-attack hits shop freezers across Europe

most_significant_event.label: Cyber-attack hits shop freezers across Europe
most_significant_event.summary: Coordinated cyber-attack causes freezers to reach 50C in seven EU countries. Infrastructure vulnerability affecting Portugal and European food supply chain.
most_significant_event.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
